text: Combining quasi-fiscal policy, increasing benefits attached to tokens, with monetary policy, increasing supply in circulation, may or may not have an effect on the market price of the tokens.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Crypto Economics - The Top 100 Token Models Compared (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3249860

isBasedOn.name: Crypto Economics - The Top 100 Token Models Compared

abstract: The combined effect of quasi-fiscal policy (increasing benefits associated with the tokens) and monetary policy (increasing the token supply in circulation) may or may not have an effect on the market price of the respective tokens.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: when benefit increases and supply increases are applied simultaneously
